prog = programs/'task-774da8b9.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 8 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    shape = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    copies = sum(value == 4 for row in grid for value in row)
    return [part * copies for part in shape]
'''
